 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.667/2022, registered at Police Station-Kotwali, District Tikamgarh (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(2) (n) of IPC and Section 7/8 of POCSO Act, 2012.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and falsely being implicated in the case.
Prosecutrix is major about 18 years of age.
Applicant is a young man.
He is in jail since 13.04.2023.
In these circumstances, applicant be released on bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail and submitted that prosecutrix was minor at the time of incident.

It is further submitted that Viran Raikwar vs State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143368681/

sentences.text: FSL report is positive.
In these circumstances, application be dismissed.
4. Learned counsel appearing for objector submitted that prosecturix has filed an affidavit that she has no objection if application is released on bail.

5. Heard the counsel for the parties.
6.
Prosecutrix has stated that she has lodged report under influence of family member.
Prosecutrix is minor aged about 17 years.
There is strong possibility that she may be affected by persuasion of her family members in lodging complaint against the applicant.
Now, prosecutrix has become major and she has given an affidavit that she has no objection if applicant is released on bail.
7. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

8. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.
9. The applicant shall also abide by the conditions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. C.C. as per rules.
(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE sp/-
